examples.translation: sie platzten mit den Leibern aufeinander
examples.raw: nqərre ruḥaye b-an=nawqat də-ḥḏoḏe ʻsie platzten mit den Leibern aufeinanderʼ; 95/119;
nqəlle ruḥe ʻer stürzte sich aufʼ; 254; 95/155 (where?);

examples.turoyo: 25. As+sobahkàr koṯən, kəmḥalqi ruḥayye lu+baḥar, koduʕri. Mḥalqi ruḥayye lu+baḥar. Ga, u+zʕuro ínaqqa domar ‘ay’, i+Ndaṯalo nqīr‿ebe. Nqīr‿ebe, mədla ŭ ṭʕəḷḷa.
examples.translation: The swimmers come, they toss themselves into the sea, they return. They toss themselves into the sea. Look,  the boy, when he says ‘oh!’, the Theotokos swooped down onto him, she swooped down onto him, she grabbed him and carried him off. (Mother Mary Saves the Sultan’s Son)
examples.raw:
25. As+sobahkàr koṯən, kəmḥalqi ruḥayye lu+baḥar, koduʕri. Mḥalqi ruḥayye lu+baḥar. Ga, u+zʕuro ínaqqa domar ‘ay’, i+Ndaṯalo nqīr‿ebe. Nqīr‿ebe, mədla ŭ ṭʕəḷḷa.
The swimmers come, they toss themselves into the sea, they return. They toss themselves into the sea. Look,  the boy, when he says ‘oh!’, the Theotokos swooped down onto him, she swooped down onto him, she grabbed him and carried him off. (Mother Mary Saves the Sultan’s Son)

examples.translation: I am standing – the bird crashed into me
examples.raw: Ono kalyo – u+safruno nqīr ebi ‘I am standing – the bird crashed into me’ (Abdu+Lmasīḥ)
